blocks.text: Central Meadows Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Central Meadows is the Harris Road town-centre pocket of Pitt Meadows, and the City publishes no official neighbourhood boundary for the name.
The closest official planning name is the Official Community Plan (OCP) Municipal Town Centre, which embraces Harris Road and the North Lougheed Area and includes the Civic Centre.
City Hall at 12007 Harris Road is the civic anchor of the pocket, on the main street the Town Centre is built around.

The working edges for a house buyer are Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) at the north, the Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC) rail line along Hammond Road through the middle, and Harris Road as the main street; Mid Meadows lies to the south-east, North Meadows across Lougheed Highway, and Maple Ridge to the east.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Houses here are the detached homes on the side streets off Harris Road, inside the urban core the City concentrates growth in, surrounded by farmland outside the Urban Containment Boundary.

The City's 2025 amendment work states the direction plainly: most new homes are expected to be multi-unit dwellings, and the proportion of single-detached dwellings is expected to decline as they are gradually replaced by denser housing types.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Flood and dike rules come first for a Central Meadows house, ahead of the zoning.

About 78 percent of Pitt Meadows' land base is in the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) and over 85 percent lies in the Fraser, Pitt and Alouette river floodplains, so a house lot's dike, drainage and floodplain status is a City check, not an assumption.

The Town Centre is also a Development Permit Area: Development Permit Area No. 8, Town Centre, applies in this pocket, so exterior and site changes on a house lot can need a development permit as well as a building permit.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Pitt Meadows Elementary is at 11941 Harris Road and Pitt Meadows Secondary is at 19438 116B Avenue, so the two locator schools for the Harris Road sample sit on or just off the Harris Road corridor itself.
The City collects property taxes and utility fees in one combined bill, so a house buyer's annual City bill is not taxes alone.
The City is working to transform Harris Road into a complete street under its Active Transportation Plan, which is the street most Central Meadows house streets feed into.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Harris Road rail separation, Harris Road at the Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC) crossing, City of Pitt Meadows project: grade separation of road and rail traffic at Harris Road to improve traffic flow and emergency response — STATUS: City project in progress on the City projects page, read 2026-11-03.

North Lougheed Area, north side of Lougheed Highway at Harris Road, City of Pitt Meadows Official Community Plan (OCP) amendment, Bylaw No. 2869, 2020: the area was added to the Municipal Town Centre and General Urban Area, for high and medium density multi-family and mixed-use development — STATUS: OCP amendment adopted, read 2026-11-03.

Harris Road Complete Street, Harris Road corridor, City of Pitt Meadows: redesign of Harris Road as a complete street under the Active Transportation Plan, for all ages and abilities — STATUS: City project listed as in exploration and design, read 2026-11-03.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Budget the drainage levy as its own line, because Pitt Meadows charges it separately from the general rate.

The 2026 Annual Tax Rates Bylaw No. 3047, 2026 sets a separate drainage rate in Schedule A alongside the general municipal rate, and taxes under that bylaw were due July 2, 2026, with 5 percent added after July 2, 2026 and a further 5 percent after August 1, 2026.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Houses: getting around

items.t: Harris Road is the spine: the Town Centre was planned around high-frequency transit services along Harris Road and Lougheed Highway and walking distance to the West Coast Express station.
Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) is the east-west highway at the north edge of the pocket, toward Maple Ridge east and the Pitt River Bridge west.

blocks.text: Central Meadows Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check flood, dike and drainage status for the specific lot with the City first: over 85 percent of the city is floodplain and the urban core drains through the Area 3 Kennedy dike drainage area.
Check Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) status per parcel: about 78 percent of the city's land base is ALR, and a house lot at the urban edge can sit next to, or partly in, farm land.
Check rail noise and crossing delay for any lot near Hammond Road or Harris Road: the City's own grade-separation project exists because road and rail traffic currently cross at grade at Harris Road.
Check Development Permit Area No. 8, Town Centre, before planning exterior work: the Official Community Plan (OCP) applies a town-centre development permit area in this pocket.

blocks.text: Central Meadows home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

32 houses sold in Central Meadows with a median price of $1,164,500 (the middle half sold between $1,057,750 and $1,307,000), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $522 per square foot, a median year built of 1987 and a median lot of 6,072 square feet.
